questions.prompt: The Domesday Book was commissioned by which king?
questions.fact: Its purpose was almost entirely fiscal: he wanted to know exactly what the country could be taxed.

questions.prompt: Which class of animal are dolphins?
questions.fact: They sleep with one half of the brain at a time, because breathing for them is a conscious act.

questions.prompt: Which sport is played at Roland Garros?
questions.fact: The venue is named after a First World War aviator, not a tennis player.

questions.prompt: Which film features the fictional Dunder Mifflin paper company?
questions.fact: It is a television series rather than a film, which is the trap in this question.

questions.prompt: Which lake sits on the border of Bolivia and Peru?
questions.fact: At over 3,800 metres it is the highest navigable lake in the world, with commercial ferries operating on it.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Cloud Atlas?
questions.fact: Its six nested stories run forward then backward, so the first is also the last.

questions.prompt: Which technology powers most electric vehicle batteries today?
questions.fact: The chemistry won a Nobel Prize in 2019, roughly thirty years after it first reached consumers in camcorders.
